items.author: Trump
items.text: Everyone knows that Canada doesn’t let our Great Dairy Farmers sell into the Canadian Market, and that the only reason Canada makes Autos is because of previous disastrous Trade Agreements while other Presidents were in Office. Canada has been ripping us off for years, but what many do not realize is that the Canadian Government, including Canadian Provinces, have banned American Small Businesses and Companies from selling into their Government Procurement Markets. This is the case even though Canada gets broad access into the massive American Government Procurement Market, including those of
items.summary_cn: 特朗普抨击加拿大长期在乳制品、汽车、政府采购上对美国不公，暗示可能再加关税施压——汽车与贸易摩擦升温，间接利空风电出口预期（02208 金风科技面向全球市场，含北美项目）。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Rages Over Alex Gibney’s ‘Hit Piece’ Documentary ‘Musk’: ‘Horrible Human’
items.summary_cn: 马斯克怒骂 Alex Gibney 纪录片为'人身攻击'，媒体形象承压，对 SpaceX 系未上市资产（SPCX/SPCH）有间接情绪面影响。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Tesla’s Cybercab Launch: Why Markets Were So Underwhelmed by Elon Musk’s Robotaxi Showcase
items.summary_cn: 市场对马斯克 Tesla Cybercab（Robotaxi）发布会反应冷淡，叙事降温，未点名具体标的但对电动车/Robotaxi 主题偏空信号。

items.author: Trump
items.text: “Words of Wisdom” from Phil Flynn, one of the World’s Great Oil and Energy Analysts — A MUST SEE! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普转发力挺知名能源/原油分析师 Phil Flynn 的观点，对能源板块整体看多背书。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Lawmakers call on Elon Musk to explain lack of DOGE claimed DHS savings
items.summary_cn: 国会议员要求马斯克解释 DOGE 在 DHS 宣称节省开支的缺口，DOGE 信用遭质疑，间接利空 Musk 系生态。
